instruction.text: Schreibe das fehlende Wort in die Lücke.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1_chirp'>It feels good to have a goal to work towards.</voice>
atoms.b: It feels good to have a ((goal)) to work for.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1_chirp'>I bet my future self would give me the advice to keep following my dreams.</voice>
atoms.b: I bet my ((future)) self would give me the advice to keep following my dreams.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1_chirp'>It's annoying how everybody thinks they need to build a family in the future. First, I want to live for myself.</voice>
atoms.b: It's annoying how everybody thinks they need to build a ((family)) in the future. First, I want to live for myself.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_chirp'>Sometimes, our uncertain future worries me. Climate change, financial insecurity, job loss: Nothing really feels safe anymore.</voice>
atoms.b: Sometimes, our uncertain future worries me. Climate change, financial insecurity, job loss: ((Nothing)) really feels safe anymore.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>I am most excited to be independent. I finally get to do what I really want in life.</voice>
atoms.b: I am most excited to be independent. I finally get to do what I really ((want)) in life.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>It is inspiring to talk to others about their future plans since you always get new perspectives on life.</voice>
atoms.b: It is inspiring to talk to others ((about)) their future plans since you always get new perspectives on life.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_chirp'>Some people have a detailed idea for what they are going to do after school, while others just wait and see what will happen.</voice>
atoms.b: Some people have a detailed idea for what they are going to do after ((school)), while others just wait and see what will happen.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_chirp'>We cannot predict if we will achieve our goals, but we can work for them.</voice>
atoms.b: We cannot predict if we will achieve our goals, but we can work towards ((them)).

instruction.text: Leyla erzählt von ihren Zukunftsplänen. Wie könnte der Beginn ihres Vision-Boards aussehen? Wähle aus.

hint.text: Ein Vision-Board ist eine selbstgemachte Collage, die persönliche Zukunftspläne visualisiert.
hint.sound: Ein <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>Vision-Board</lang> ist eine selbstgemachte Collage, die persönliche Zukunftspläne visualisiert.
hint.label: Vision-Board

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f9_chirp'>When I think about my future, I really hope to live somewhere close to the ocean. There is nothing better than relaxing on a calm, warm beach in the summer and just listening to the sound of the waves. Spending quality time with people I love is also super important to me, so I always imagine myself hanging out with my friends, having a cup of tea or coffee, and talking for hours.</voice>

atoms.text: Vervollständige das Vision-Board, indem du die richtigen Bilder einfügst.

instruction.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f9_chirp'>To stay active, I definitely want to keep playing my favourite sport in the future. I’ve been playing tennis for a few years now, and hitting the ball on the court always helps me clear my mind.</voice>

instruction.text: Vervollständige das Vision-Board, indem du die richtigen Bilder einfügst.
instruction.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f9_chirp'>I’ve also realized that I’m definitely a summer person because I just love warm, sunny days. Strolling under green summer trees with full, bright leaves always puts me in a great mood. During my free time, I also really enjoy working outside in the garden, planting colorful flowers, and taking care of vegetables.</voice>

instruction.text: Vervollständige das Vision-Board, indem du die richtigen Bilder einfügst.
instruction.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f9_chirp'>When it comes to my career, I’ve had a clear dream for a long time. I want to become a police officer so I can help people in my community and keep my neighbourhood safe. Driving in a police car and dealing with new challenges every day sounds super exciting to me.</voice>

instruction.text: Vervollständige das Vision-Board, indem du die richtigen Bilder einfügst.
instruction.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f9_chirp'> Finally, my future home wouldn't be complete without a pet. I really want to adopt a big dog that can accompany me on long outdoor walks. Having a loyal dog by my side has always been a big dream of mine.</voice>
